name: Wafer Lock Picking
description: Wafer locks are common in filing cabinets, desk drawers, interior doors, and low-security padlocks. They use flat wafers instead of pin stacks and are generally less secure than pin tumbler locks. Wafer pick sets navigate the wafer geometry and open most of these locks quickly. File cabinets and desk drawers at a target often contain the highest-value intelligence — credentials, access documentation, physical keys — making this technique disproportionately valuable relative to the minimal effort required.

blue.det: Time at cabinet or furniture lock without key; pick tool visible in keyway; lock opened without authorized key.
blue.cm: Replace wafer lock furniture with electronic access or high-security pin tumbler locks for sensitive storage; key control policy; camera coverage of sensitive storage areas.
